newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Industry group to present report on info society.
newsitem.headline: Industry group to present report on info society.

text.p: A high-level industry advisory group will present a report to the European Commission on Thursday in Potsdam, Germany, on ways to promote the information society, Commission spokesman Jochen Kubosch said.

The group will hold a news conference that will be attended by Industry Commissioner Martin Bangemann, Thomas Middlehoff, a member of the board of German media group Bertelsmann AG; and Etienne Davignon, president of Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique, he said.
Middlehoff heads a working group on standardisation and electronic commerce and Davignon one on competitiveness, employment, education and training.

Kubosch said he was not sure whether Carlo De Benedetti, former chairman of Italian computer company Olivetti, would attend. De Benedetti, who heads a third working group on regulatory issues, resigned his executive post at Olivetti in September.

The industry group, which includes about 30 company executives, is known as "Bangemann II" because it is the successor to a group that issued a report on ways to promote the "information society," or computer and telecommunications technology, in 1994.
